name: GitHub: Expired Personal Access Tokens
query:
MATCH (token)
WHERE (token:GH_PersonalAccessToken AND token.token_expired = true) OR (token:GH_ClassicPersonalAccessToken AND token.credential_state = 'expired')
OPTIONAL MATCH p=(:GH_User)-[:GH_HasPersonalAccessToken]->(token)
RETURN token, p
LIMIT 1000
description: Finds expired fine-grained and classic personal access tokens, including tokens whose owner could not be resolved. Expired tokens should be cleaned up to reduce credential inventory and audit noise.
